transactions_trigger.name: trg_update_wallet_balance
transactions_trigger.behavior: If NEW.type = 'fund' AND NEW.status = 'completed', credits wallets.wallet_balance by NEW.amount where user_id = NEW.recipient_id

double_credit_mechanism.summary: Live fund_wallet inserts transactions(type='fund', recipient_id=p_user_id, status='completed') which fires trg_update_wallet_balance (+p_amount), then also UPDATE wallets SET wallet_balance = wallet_balance + p_amount (+p_amount). Net +2 * p_amount.
double_credit_mechanism.prior_probe_note: Earlier insert-only probes showed delta 0 when recipient_id was unset; trigger requires recipient_id, so those probes understated hypothesis A.

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fund_wallet(p_user_id uuid, p_amount numeric)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
begin
  -- Ensure wallet exists
  insert into public.wallets (user_id, wallet_balance)
  values (p_user_id, 0)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;

  -- Insert transaction
  insert into public.transactions (
    sender_id,
    recipient_id,
    amount,
    type,
    status
  )
  values (
    null,
    p_user_id,
    p_amount,
    'fund',
    'completed'
  );

  -- Update wallet balance
  update public.wallets
  set wallet_balance = wallet_balance + p_amount
  where user_id = p_user_id;

end;
$function$
